def transform(g):

    cnt=Counter(x for r in a for x in r)

    for i,r in enumerate(a):
        for j,x in enumerate(r):
            if x==single: sc,sr=j,i
    bar=[c for c,n in cnt.items() if c!=single and n<=cnt[[k for k in cnt if k not in (single,) and k!=c][0]]]
    # bar color = non-single color with min count
    bar=min([c for c in cnt if c!=single], key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    rows=[i for i,r in enumerate(a) if bar in r]

    bcols=[j for j,x in enumerate(a[bot]) if x==bar]
    ts,bs=min(tcols),min(bcols)
    newcol=bs+(sc-ts)
    for i in range(0,bot):
        a[i][newcol]=single
    a[sr][sc]=4
    return a
